text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: One blank, folded twice: a 27 x 62 mm leg that screws to the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: plate; a 46 x 38 mm wing folded 90 degrees at the dock end;

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: a 27 x 30 mm shelf folded 90 degrees at the top.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Leg: two 4.5 mm holes, 13 in from the dock end, 12 and 52 up.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Wing: holes for the robot contact block (three copper strips

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: on an 8 mm insulating block) on its dock-facing side.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Shelf: 7 mm hole for the latch pin, 15 from the dock end,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 17 in from the plate; solenoid screw holes from its datasheet.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: on the lower plate's inner face at the dock end,
